title: Standby assignment artifact references
observed_behavior: Kind 31402 standby node definitions decoded worker, service, tier, support, and profile data, but no artifact/image reference was projected into Worker.StandbyAssignments for cleanup protection.
intended_behavior: Standby node definitions may carry an artifact_ref. Relay projection applies each standby definition to the target Worker.StandbyAssignments entry, preserving artifact_ref per service assignment so cleanup keep-lists can protect standby images.
